natural_body: Price-sensitive SMB 40% off: signups +31%, rev +18%, retention -12%.

first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and two independent inherited records indicate that reducing onboarding friction improved completion, time-to-value, and early adoption. This directly addresses the current bottleneck without the demonstrated retention downside of broad promotional pricing. Verify both source records before committing to confirm segment, magnitude, and durability details; run as a standard experiment with qualified-revenue and downstream retention guardrails.
